title: Add firearms, magazine/chamber state, unload/reload actions, gunshot acoustics, and cross-way shooting

sections.what: Extend Viwo's ranged combat (engine/combat.py) for firearms: weapon-held ammo (detachable magazine item via EDGE_IN container ops or internal gun uses), thin reload/unload verb sugar over existing container/uses ops, DEX-based non-approaching ranged rolls, cross-area targeting along engine/beyond_visibility.py sightline_run, and transient gunshot alerting built on engine/sound.py propagate_sound.
sections.why: task-518 implemented same-area bow firing in engine/combat.py (_is_ranged_weapon lines 835-843, _carried_ammo_node lines 845-861, _spend_ammo lines 863-892, check at lines 460-466) using loose carried ammo items, approach_character (line 371), and STR (line 476), while routes/action_handlers.py (line 1715) blocks cross-room attack targets. Meanwhile, put_item_in_container (engine/items/place_actions.py:34) and take_item (engine/items/take_drop_actions.py:395) already handle moving items into/out of containers (EDGE_IN), and engine/sound.py (propagate_sound, lines 136-223) is a pure Dijkstra query that returns {area_id: (remaining_pen, dir)} without emitting events or alerting NPCs.
sections.how:
1. Weapon & ammo state (engine/combat.py): For firearms (e.g. firearm/gun tag alongside ranged), check ammo on the weapon itself rather than _carried_ammo_node: either an EDGE_IN magazine child item's uses (via place_actions.py container edges) or the gun's own uses/max_uses (with 0 = empty, not auto-destroyed). Fail cleanly with a firearm-appropriate empty message when 0.
2. reload / unload verbs (engine/actions.py, routes/action_handlers.py, static/js/agent/plan-grounding.ts, static/js/agent/prompt-builder/contextual-actions.ts): For magazine-fed guns, reuse put_item_in_container (EDGE_IN) and take_item (EDGE_IN -> EDGE_CARRYING) rather than duplicating container logic in transfer_actions.py. For internal-magazine/cylinder guns, add a small uses-transfer helper from carried ammo into the gun's uses.
3. Ranged attack mechanics (engine/combat.py, routes/action_handlers.py): Skip approach_character for ranged attacks; roll DEX instead of STR for ranged weapons; allow attack <target> in routes/action_handlers.py and validate_action_command to resolve targets in areas returned by engine/beyond_visibility.py (sightline_run) when wielding a ranged weapon (preserving task-518 bow behavior).
4. Gunshot acoustics (engine/combat.py, engine/sound.py): Call propagate_sound (or get_areas_hearing_sound_source) on firearm discharge (unless suppressed) and deliver transient directional gunshot turn events / NPC alerts to the returned area_ids (rather than treating sound_source item scans as one-shot events).
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest tests/test_ranged_combat.py plus new tests covering weapon-local magazine/uses reload & unload, empty-chamber click, DEX/no-approach ranged attack, sightline_run cross-area targeting, and propagate_sound gunshot alerting.

acceptance.text: Firearms read ammo from the weapon itself (an EDGE_IN magazine child item's uses or the gun's own uses/max_uses) rather than loose carried ammo, failing cleanly on empty without destroying the gun.
Magazine-fed load/unload reuses existing container ops (put_item_in_container / take_item) with optional reload/unload verb sugar; internal-magazine guns transfer uses from carried ammo.

Ranged attacks skip approach_character, roll DEX instead of STR, and resolve targets along engine/beyond_visibility.py sightline_run areas in routes/action_handlers.py while preserving task-518 bow/quiver behavior.
Firing an unsuppressed firearm queries engine/sound.py propagate_sound and delivers transient directional gunshot alerts/turn events to reachable areas and NPCs.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal weapon action brackets (`reload`, `unload`), Inspector item properties, and Event Stream acoustic gunshot alerts.

Current availability: task-518 implemented same-area bow firing in engine/combat.py (_is_ranged_weapon, _carried_ammo_node, _spend_ammo) with approach_character and STR rolls; put_item_in_container / take_item already handle container EDGE_IN moves; propagate_sound is query-only and routes/action_handlers.py blocks cross-area attack.

Manual verification steps:
1. Equip a pistol/rifle with an EDGE_IN magazine (and spare magazine/ammo) and run `unload <weapon>` (or `take <mag>`), attempt attack while empty, then `reload <weapon>` (or `put <mag> in <weapon>`) and fire along an open sightline near an adjacent connected room.
   - expected: Empty chamber fails cleanly, reload/unload moves the magazine or transfers uses, ranged attack rolls DEX without approaching, cross-way target resolves along sightline_run, and firing delivers directional gunshot alerts to reachable rooms.
